meta.name: qdrant-sizing
meta.description: Sizes a Qdrant deployment before it is provisioned. Use when someone asks 'how much RAM do I need', 'how many nodes', 'how big should my cluster be', 'sizing', 'capacity planning', 'will N vectors fit', 'what instance type should I pick', or gives a vector count and dimensions and asks what to provision. Also use when an existing estimate needs checking before hardware or a cluster tier is bought.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 估算 Qdrant 部署所需内存与节点数
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在规划 Qdrant 集群规模,需要预估内存与节点数。
copy.tagline_en: Estimate the memory and nodes needed for a Qdrant deployment.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're planning a Qdrant cluster and need to estimate memory and node count.

howto.what: 当用户询问 Qdrant 部署需要哪些资源时，Claude 会引导用户提供向量数量、维度、负载等参数，按组件计算内存、磁盘、CPU、GPU 和节点数，并提醒留出余量和用官方计算器验证。
howto.when: 当用户询问所需内存、节点数、集群规模等容量规划问题，或给出向量数和维度询问配置，或要求检查已有估算时触发。

say.text: 我有 1000 万条 768 维向量，需要多少 RAM？
say.note: Claude 会收集副本数、负载等信息后估算内存。

say.text: 帮我规划一个 Qdrant 集群，目标 p95 延迟 50ms。
say.note: Claude 会询问吞吐和容灾要求，给出节点和资源配置。

say.text: 检查一下这个 8 节点配置是否够用。
say.note: Claude 会复核现有估算并建议用计算器交叉核对。

howto.what_en: When asked to size a Qdrant deployment, Claude guides the user to provide vector count, dimensions, and workload parameters, then estimates RAM, disk, CPU, GPU, and node count per component, reminding to leave headroom and to verify with the official calculator.
howto.when_en: Triggered when someone asks about RAM, node count, cluster size, or other capacity questions, provides vector count/dimensions and asks what to provision, or wants an existing estimate checked before buying hardware or cluster tier.

say_en.text: I have 10M vectors of 768 dims; how much RAM do I need?
say_en.note: Claude will ask about replication and load, then estimate memory.

say_en.text: Help me size a Qdrant cluster for p95 50ms latency.
Check if this 8-node setup is sufficient.
say_en.note: Claude will review the estimate and suggest the sizing calculator.
